proof_explanation: The negate function now correctly returns Bool.not(value), which directly implements total Boolean negation. The law negate_matches_boolean_not is satisfied trivially: since negate(value) definitionally reduces to Bool.not(value), the equality negate(value) == Bool.not(value) holds by reflexivity. The proof {==} establishes this reflexive equality.

seeded_attack.reason: The seeded attack fails to implement proper Boolean negation. It does not ensure negate(true) returns false and negate(false) returns true, violating the law negate_matches_boolean_not which requires negate(value) == Bool.not(value) for all Bool values.
